selection: Highest Packagist download count among recorded hits whose own source parses JSON text: seld/jsonlint (252,371,311). Higher-download JSON helpers (nette/utils, symfony/serializer) wrap json_decode.
uncertainty: Pilot cell: PHP JSON parsing is dominated by the bundled ext/json json_decode; most popular Packagist JSON packages wrap it. Only seld/jsonlint, the highest-download package with its own pure-PHP parser, was built and control-verified. Its downloads are inflated by Composer, which depends on it but calls json_decode first and uses JsonParser for error reports. Seven own-parser or partial-own-parser leads are logged in leads.json and are not verified or ranked; four json_decode wrappers are excluded. Non-parser hits such as JWT, JSON Schema, JSONPath, JMESPath, serializers and JSON-RPC were not treated as leads. One valid nested object control does not establish complete RFC 8259 support.
